name: End screen
what: The last seconds of a video: a title, one or two video cards (where the platform's end-screen links go) sliding in, the channel's round picture popping in a turning ring and a Subscribe button that pulses. Side by side on a wide frame, stacked on a tall one.
origin: end screens - the template kinds marketplaces list (Mixkit, Envato Elements, Motion Array, Videohive), researched 2026-10-16
motion: title rises 16 f; cards slide 18 f (power3.out, 5 f apart), play buttons breathe; picture back.out 14 f in a turning ring; the button pops, pulses every 40 f
